useful_material: This study provides a mechanistic framework for how gut microbiota can trigger autoimmune myocarditis, specifically citing *Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron* where bacterial beta-galactosidase shares sequence homology with cardiac MyHC-α, inducing Th17 polarization. It also details a downstream signaling pathway in myocarditis involving Tenascin-C (TN-C) activating dendritic cells via TLR4 to produce IL-6, IL-1β, and GM-CSF, driving Th17 differentiation.
